summary: Commerce is broken down along the APQC Process Classification Framework's selling (3.0) and customer-service (6.0) categories for the cross-industry functions: customer relationships, campaigns, advertising, measurement, and service. NAICS 44-45, 72, 53 and 81 service lines decide the store, restaurant, lodging, property and personal-service capabilities. Task boundaries inside those capabilities follow ARTS (retail), OpenTravel and HTNG (lodging), RESO (real estate) and IAB Tech Lab (advertising) where they draw a line. Leaves are drawn at the level where a problem has fixed inputs and outputs: demand forecasting, product search, click prediction, room revenue management, workforce staffing and automated valuation have public datasets or reference solutions, but most record-keeping leaves do not.

capabilities.name: Customer relationship management
capabilities.definition: Given contacts, accounts and interactions, maintain a unified customer record and move prospects through a sales process to closed revenue.

crosswalk.label: Market and Sell Products and Services

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Customer relationship management and sales force automation'; renamed, since sales force automation is the pipeline, forecast and territory tasks here. Donor management is placed here because its function (relationship records, solicitation, pledges) is CRM with gift-specific objects. Industry CRMs for insurance agencies, financial advisors, collections and law firms are handed off to govern.

tasks.name: Contact and account records
tasks.definition: Given contact details and logged interactions, keep one current record per person and organization with relationships and activity history.
tasks.inputs: contacts, organizations, emails, calls, meetings, notes
tasks.outputs: deduplicated contact and account records with activity timelines and relationships
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: data-model and import conformance can be tested, record-keeping quality has no reference answer

tasks.name: Lead and opportunity management
tasks.definition: Given inbound leads and sales activity, score and route leads and track opportunities through pipeline stages to won or lost.
tasks.inputs: leads with source and firmographic or behavioral attributes, rep assignments, stage rules
tasks.outputs: lead scores and assignments, opportunity stages, conversion rates
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: lead-conversion prediction can be scored on public marketing datasets such as the UCI Bank Marketing set; routing has no reference answer

tasks.name: Sales pipeline forecasting
tasks.definition: Given open opportunities, their stages and history, forecast bookings by period with a range.
tasks.inputs: opportunity snapshots over time, stage history, rep commits, historical win rates
tasks.outputs: period revenue forecast with confidence range, at-risk deals
onet_products: Software on Sailboats Desktop Sales Manager
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: backtests on historical pipeline snapshots work, but public pipeline datasets are scarce

tasks.name: Territory and quota planning
tasks.definition: Given accounts, geography, potential and rep capacity, design balanced sales territories and set quotas.
tasks.inputs: accounts with location and potential, rep headcount and capacity, prior sales
tasks.outputs: territory assignments, workload and potential balance measures, quotas
onet_products: Cegedim Target Software Target SFA Pharmaceutical Suite
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: territory design is a districting optimization whose balance and compactness can be scored, though no standard instance set exists

tasks.name: Quote and proposal configuration
tasks.definition: Given a product catalog with configuration and pricing rules and a customer's needs, produce a valid configured, priced quote.
tasks.inputs: product options and compatibility rules, price lists, discount approvals, customer requirements
tasks.outputs: valid configuration, priced quote document, approval routing

crosswalk.label: Develop and manage sales proposals, bids, and quotes

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: configuration is constraint satisfaction with checkable validity; price correctness can be tested against rule sets

tasks.name: Donor and fundraising management
tasks.definition: Given donors, gifts, pledges and prospect wealth data, record giving, target solicitations and produce acknowledgements.
tasks.inputs: donor records, gifts and pledges, campaign codes, wealth and philanthropy indicators
tasks.outputs: giving histories, receipts and acknowledgements, prospect ratings, solicitation lists
tasks.benchmarkable: no: record-keeping with no reference answer

capabilities.name: Marketing campaign automation
capabilities.definition: Given audiences, content and rules, plan and execute marketing campaigns across owned channels and record responses.
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Marketing automation, advertising and web analytics' split three ways: owned-channel campaigns (here), paid media buying (advertising), and measurement and research (marketing_analytics). Loyalty programs are placed here because they are rules-driven retention marketing; stored-value tender stays at the point of sale.

tasks.name: Email campaign delivery
tasks.definition: Given a subscriber list, consent status and message content, send personalized email campaigns and record deliveries, opens, clicks and unsubscribes.
tasks.inputs: subscriber lists, consent flags, templates and personalization fields, send schedule
tasks.outputs: sent messages, bounce and complaint handling, engagement metrics, updated suppression lists
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: deliverability and rendering can be measured against seed lists; campaign quality cannot

tasks.name: Customer journey automation
tasks.definition: Given behavioral triggers and branching rules, run multi-step, multi-channel nurture sequences per customer.
tasks.inputs: event streams, profile attributes, journey definitions with waits, branches and goals
tasks.outputs: per-customer message sequences, journey state, goal conversions
tasks.benchmarkable: no: correctness is rule execution; value depends on live customers

tasks.name: Audience segmentation and targeting
tasks.definition: Given customer attributes and behavior, build segments and propensity or uplift scores that decide who receives which offer.
tasks.inputs: customer profiles, transaction and engagement history, past campaign responses
tasks.outputs: segments, propensity or uplift scores, target lists
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: public uplift datasets such as the Criteo uplift set and Hillstrom email data have held-out treatment outcomes
tasks.notes: Generic clustering and classification belong to science machine learning; this leaf is the offer-targeting problem.

tasks.name: Loyalty program management
tasks.definition: Given member transactions and program rules, accrue and redeem points, assign tiers and issue rewards.
tasks.inputs: member enrollments, purchase transactions, earn and burn rules, tier thresholds
tasks.outputs: point balances, tier status, reward issuance, liability totals
tasks.benchmarkable: no: rule execution with no reference problem set
tasks.notes: No O*NET product names loyalty explicitly; the function is common in POS and CRM suites.

tasks.name: Marketing plan and budget management
tasks.definition: Given marketing objectives, budgets and planned activities, maintain a campaign calendar, allocate spend and track assets and approvals.
tasks.inputs: budgets, planned campaigns and channels, creative assets, approval workflows
tasks.outputs: marketing calendar, budget versus actual, approved asset library
tasks.benchmarkable: no: planning workflow with no reference answer

capabilities.name: Advertising buying and serving
capabilities.definition: Given campaign goals, budgets, audiences and creatives, buy paid media in ad auctions and decide which ad fills each impression.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Split out of seed 'Marketing automation, advertising and web analytics'. The task split follows IAB Tech Lab's buy-side and sell-side roles. Creative production goes to media.

tasks.name: Search advertising campaign management
tasks.definition: Given keywords, ad copy, budgets and conversion goals, set and adjust bids in search-engine ad auctions to maximize conversions within budget.
tasks.inputs: keyword lists and match types, ad copy, budgets, bid strategies, conversion data
tasks.outputs: keyword bids, budget pacing, impressions, clicks, cost and conversions
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: bidding policies can be compared in auction simulators such as AuctionGym, but live auction data is proprietary

tasks.name: Programmatic real-time bidding
tasks.definition: Given a bid request with impression and audience context, campaign budgets and targeting, decide within milliseconds whether to bid, at what price and with which creative.
tasks.inputs: OpenRTB bid requests, campaign targeting and budgets, audience segments, predicted response rates
tasks.outputs: bid responses with price and creative, spend pacing, win and delivery logs
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the iPinYou real-time bidding dataset supports offline replay of bid strategies under budget
tasks.notes: No O*NET product names a demand-side platform.

tasks.name: Ad response prediction
tasks.definition: Given impression, user and ad features, predict the probability of a click or conversion.
tasks.inputs: impression logs with user, context and ad features; click and conversion labels
tasks.outputs: calibrated click-through and conversion probabilities
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: Criteo and Avazu click logs are standard leaderboards scored by log loss and AUC
tasks.notes: Kept as a leaf apart from bidding because it is the part with public benchmarks.

tasks.name: Publisher ad serving and yield
tasks.definition: Given a publisher's ad slots, sold line items and programmatic demand, choose the ad for each impression and pace delivery to contracts while maximizing revenue.
tasks.inputs: ad slot definitions, line items with goals and priorities, header-bidding and exchange bids
tasks.outputs: ad decisions per impression, delivery pacing, revenue and fill reports
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: guaranteed-delivery allocation is an online matching problem with known optima on synthetic instances

capabilities.name: Marketing measurement and research
capabilities.definition: Given behavioral, spend, survey and market data, measure what marketing caused and what customers and markets want.

crosswalk.label: Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Split from seed 'Marketing automation, advertising and web analytics' and extended with market research. Survey instrument design, telephone interviewing and general statistics stay in science; conjoint, attribution and trade-area modeling are marketing-specific methods and live here.

tasks.name: Web and app traffic analytics
tasks.definition: Given clickstream events from sites and apps, compute sessions, traffic sources, funnels and conversions.
tasks.inputs: page-view and event logs, campaign tags, conversion definitions
tasks.outputs: sessions, users, source attribution, funnel and retention reports
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: sessionization and attribution rules can be checked against reference logs, but definitions differ by vendor

tasks.name: Site tag management
tasks.definition: Given measurement and advertising tags and firing rules, deploy and govern them on a site under consent settings.
tasks.inputs: tag templates, triggers, data-layer variables, consent signals
tasks.outputs: deployed tag configuration, fired events, consent-compliant data collection
tasks.benchmarkable: no: configuration management with no reference problem

tasks.name: Online controlled experiments
tasks.definition: Given variants, traffic allocation and metrics, run randomized tests and estimate treatment effects with valid inference.
tasks.inputs: variant definitions, assignment rules, metric events, guardrail metrics
tasks.outputs: effect estimates with intervals, sample-ratio checks, ship decisions
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: inference methods can be checked on simulated A/A and A/B data with known effects

tasks.name: Attribution and media mix modeling
tasks.definition: Given spend and exposure by channel and business outcomes over time, estimate each channel's incremental contribution and recommend budget reallocation.
tasks.inputs: channel spend and impressions by period, sales or conversions, controls such as price and seasonality
tasks.outputs: channel contributions, return on spend, response curves, optimized budget split
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: simulated marketing data with known ground-truth effects allows scoring, real data does not

tasks.name: Search engine optimization auditing
tasks.definition: Given a site and target queries, crawl it, track ranking positions and report technical and content issues that limit organic search visibility.
tasks.inputs: site URLs, target keywords, search result pages, crawl data
tasks.outputs: rank positions, crawl and indexing issues, keyword opportunities
onet_products: Search engine results pages SERP software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: technical audits are checkable against seeded test sites; ranking outcomes are not reproducible

tasks.name: Conjoint and choice modeling
tasks.definition: Given an experimental design of product profiles and respondents' choices, estimate attribute part-worths and simulate market shares.
tasks.inputs: attribute and level design, respondent choice or rating data
tasks.outputs: part-worth utilities, willingness to pay, share-of-preference simulations, perceptual maps
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: designs simulated from known part-worths give recoverable ground truth

tasks.name: Trade area and site analysis
tasks.definition: Given store or candidate locations, demographics and competitors, delineate trade areas, profile segments and forecast site sales.
tasks.inputs: site coordinates, customer origins, geodemographic segment data, competitor locations
tasks.outputs: trade-area polygons, segment profiles, gravity-model sales forecasts, ranked sites
onet_products: Geographic information system GIS marketing software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: sales forecasts can be backtested where store sales are public, which is rare
tasks.notes: General spatial analysis belongs to earth.gis; this is the retail-siting model on top of it.

capabilities.name: Point of sale and payment acceptance
capabilities.definition: Given items, prices, promotions and a customer's tender, complete the sale, take payment in person or online, and reconcile the money.
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Point of sale and retail store operations'. Store inventory and replenishment moved to merchandising. Restaurant order-taking moved to food_service because table, course and kitchen routing are distinct functions. Card networks and acquiring banks belong to govern; the merchant side of payment acceptance is here.

tasks.name: Checkout transaction processing
tasks.definition: Given scanned items, price and promotion rules, tax rules and tenders, compute the basket total and record the sale, return or exchange.
tasks.inputs: item identifiers, price book, promotion and coupon rules, tax tables, tenders
tasks.outputs: receipts, transaction log records, tax and discount breakdown
onet_products: Advanced Retail Management Systems Retail Pro
CAM Commerce Solutions Retail STAR Point of Sale POS
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Service
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: basket pricing with stacked promotions and tax has deterministic correct answers that test cases can fix

tasks.name: In-person card payment acceptance
tasks.definition: Given a card or wallet presented at a terminal and an amount, obtain authorization, capture and settle the payment securely.
tasks.inputs: chip, contactless or swipe card data, amount, merchant credentials
tasks.outputs: authorization responses, captured transactions, settlement batches
onet_products: Point of sale POS payment software
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: certification test-card suites define pass or fail, not a ranking

tasks.name: Online payment processing
tasks.definition: Given a checkout amount and a remote payment method, authorize, capture, refund and handle chargebacks through a gateway.
tasks.inputs: payment method tokens, amounts and currency, order references, dispute notices
tasks.outputs: authorizations, captures, refunds, payouts, dispute responses
tasks.benchmarkable: no: integration and reliability, not a problem with a reference answer

tasks.name: Gift card and stored value
tasks.definition: Given gift-card issuance and redemption events, maintain balances and produce outstanding-liability totals.
tasks.inputs: card issuances, reloads, redemptions, expiry rules
tasks.outputs: card balances, transaction history, outstanding liability
tasks.benchmarkable: no: ledger keeping

tasks.name: Till and cash office reconciliation
tasks.definition: Given POS tender totals and counted drawer contents, compute over and short by register and shift and prepare deposits.
tasks.inputs: register tender totals, drawer counts, pickups and loans, safe counts
tasks.outputs: over and short by cashier, deposit slips, store daily sales audit
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Service
tasks.benchmarkable: no: arithmetic bookkeeping

tasks.name: Exception-based loss prevention
tasks.definition: Given POS transaction logs, flag cashiers, returns and voids whose patterns suggest theft or fraud and build investigation cases.
tasks.inputs: transaction logs, returns, voids, discounts, employee identifiers, video references
tasks.outputs: exception reports, risk-ranked employees and transactions, case files
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: anomaly detectors can be scored on synthetic logs with seeded fraud; no labeled public data

capabilities.name: Merchandise planning, pricing and store inventory
capabilities.definition: Given sales history, costs, space and inventory, decide what each store carries, at what price, in what quantity and where on the shelf.

crosswalk.label: ARTS Operational Data Model (merchandise and inventory)

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Merchandising, pricing and retail inventory'. Generic inventory tracking, warehouses, RFID and barcoding stay with move; this capability keeps the store-facing decisions.

tasks.name: Assortment planning
tasks.definition: Given item sales history, store clusters and space limits, choose which items each store or cluster carries.
tasks.inputs: item-store sales, store attributes and clusters, space capacity, item attributes
tasks.outputs: item-by-store assortment, expected sales and margin
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: assortment optimization under a choice model has standard formulations but no public reference instances

tasks.name: Merchandise financial planning
tasks.definition: Given sales, margin and inventory targets by category and period, produce merchandise plans and open-to-buy budgets.
tasks.inputs: historical sales and margins, targets, on-hand and on-order inventory
tasks.outputs: category plans by period, open-to-buy amounts
tasks.benchmarkable: no: planning arithmetic with no reference answer

tasks.name: Price and markdown optimization
tasks.definition: Given demand response to price, inventory and season end, set regular prices and markdown schedules that maximize margin or sell-through.
tasks.inputs: price and sales history, elasticity estimates, inventory, season calendar, pricing rules
tasks.outputs: recommended prices and markdown dates, projected sell-through and margin
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: policies can be scored in simulators with known demand curves; real outcomes are proprietary

tasks.name: Promotion lift forecasting
tasks.definition: Given a promotion calendar and history, forecast incremental lift, cannibalization and halo for proposed promotions.
tasks.inputs: past promotions with mechanics, item sales, prices, calendar events
tasks.outputs: forecast lift by item and store, cannibalization estimates, promotion ROI
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: public retail panels such as the M5 Walmart data and dunnhumby The Complete Journey include promotions and support backtests

tasks.name: Planogram and shelf space planning
tasks.definition: Given fixtures, item dimensions and sales, place items on shelves to meet facing, adjacency and capacity rules.
tasks.inputs: fixture geometry, item dimensions, sales velocity, adjacency rules
tasks.outputs: planograms, facings per item, days of supply on shelf
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: shelf-space allocation is a knapsack-like optimization scorable on synthetic instances

tasks.name: Store inventory counts and shrink
tasks.definition: Given receipts, sales, transfers and physical counts at a store, reconcile book to actual inventory and report shrink.
tasks.inputs: store receipts, sales, transfers, cycle and physical counts
tasks.outputs: perpetual inventory, count variances, shrink by category
tasks.benchmarkable: no: record-keeping

capabilities.name: Online storefront and order management
capabilities.definition: Given a catalog, prices and inventory, let customers find and buy products online and route each order to fulfillment.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'E-commerce storefronts and order management'. Product search and recommendation are split out as leaves because each has public benchmarks.

tasks.name: Product catalog enrichment
tasks.definition: Given raw supplier product data, normalize attributes, classify each item into a category taxonomy and produce publishable product content.
tasks.inputs: supplier feeds, item attributes, images, category taxonomy such as GS1 GPC
tasks.outputs: classified, attribute-complete product records and channel-ready content
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: product categorization and attribute extraction have public datasets such as the Rakuten Data Challenge and Amazon product data

tasks.name: Storefront cart and checkout
tasks.definition: Given a catalog, prices, shipping and tax rules, let a shopper browse, build a cart and place a paid order.
tasks.inputs: catalog, prices and promotions, shipping and tax rules, shopper session
tasks.outputs: placed orders with totals, customer accounts, abandoned-cart events
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: the WebShop and WebArena shopping environments test agents buying on a storefront, not the storefront itself

tasks.name: Product search ranking
tasks.definition: Given a shopper's query and a product catalog, return products ranked by relevance and likelihood of purchase.
tasks.inputs: query text, catalog with titles and attributes, behavioral signals
tasks.outputs: ranked product list, facets, query corrections
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the Amazon Shopping Queries (ESCI) dataset gives graded relevance labels and a fixed metric
tasks.notes: General search engines are computing; this leaf is commerce relevance ranking.

tasks.name: Product recommendation
tasks.definition: Given shopper interaction histories and item data, rank items each shopper is most likely to buy next.
tasks.inputs: views, carts, purchases, item attributes
tasks.outputs: ranked item lists per shopper or per item context
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: public retail interaction sets such as RetailRocket, Amazon reviews and the H&M Kaggle data support ranked-metric leaderboards

tasks.name: Order orchestration and sourcing
tasks.definition: Given customer orders and inventory across stores and warehouses, choose fulfillment locations, split orders and track them through delivery and return.
tasks.inputs: orders, inventory by node, node capacities, shipping costs, service promises
tasks.outputs: sourcing assignments, order splits, status updates, return authorizations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: sourcing is a cost-minimizing assignment scorable on synthetic order streams

tasks.name: Marketplace and channel listing
tasks.definition: Given a catalog, prices and stock, publish and synchronize listings across third-party marketplaces and shopping feeds.
tasks.inputs: catalog records, channel category mappings, prices, stock levels
tasks.outputs: channel listings and product feeds, synchronized stock and prices, imported orders
tasks.benchmarkable: no: integration work

capabilities.name: Customer service and contact centers
capabilities.definition: Given customer requests arriving by phone, email, chat or web, route, answer and resolve them while staffing and measuring the service operation.

crosswalk.label: Telemarketing Bureaus and Other Contact Centers

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Contact center, helpdesk and interactive voice response'. Kept as one capability. IT help desks and service management go to computing, computer-aided emergency dispatch to govern, and telephony infrastructure (softphones, call accounting) to computing.

tasks.name: Service case tracking and routing
tasks.definition: Given inbound customer requests, create cases, classify and prioritize them, assign them to agents and track them to resolution under service-level targets.
tasks.inputs: emails, web forms, chats and calls; customer and product records; routing and SLA rules
tasks.outputs: cases with category, priority, owner, SLA timers, resolution history

crosswalk.label: Plan and manage customer service contacts

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic ticket classification and routing can be scored on labeled ticket sets; workflow cannot

tasks.name: Self-service answers and virtual agents
tasks.definition: Given a customer's question, a knowledge base, policies and back-end actions, answer or complete the request automatically or hand off to a person.
tasks.inputs: customer messages, knowledge articles, policies, order and account APIs
tasks.outputs: answers, completed account actions, escalations with context, deflection rates
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: tau-bench retail and airline tasks score policy-following agents; Banking77 and CLINC150 score intent detection

tasks.name: Complaint and feedback management
tasks.definition: Given complaints and satisfaction responses, categorize them, investigate root causes and report satisfaction measures.
tasks.inputs: complaints, survey responses, investigation notes
tasks.outputs: categorized complaint cases, root-cause codes, CSAT and NPS trends, regulatory complaint reports

crosswalk.label: Evaluate customer service operations and customer satisfaction

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: complaint classification can be scored on the public CFPB consumer complaint database; investigation cannot
tasks.notes: Patient-relations products are listed because the function is general complaint handling.

tasks.name: Automatic contact distribution
tasks.definition: Given arriving calls, chats and emails with attributes and agents with skills and states, queue each contact and deliver it to the best available agent.
tasks.inputs: contact attributes, queues, agent skills and states, routing strategies
tasks.outputs: agent assignments, queue wait times, abandonment and service-level statistics
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: routing policies can be compared in queueing simulations with fixed arrival and skill mixes

tasks.name: Interactive voice response
tasks.definition: Given a call flow and caller speech or keypad input, identify the caller's need, complete self-service steps and route the remainder.
tasks.inputs: call-flow definitions, prompts, grammars or language models, back-end lookups
tasks.outputs: completed self-service transactions, captured intents, routed calls, containment rate
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: spoken intent and slot recognition can be scored on public spoken-language datasets; call flows cannot

tasks.name: Outbound and predictive dialing
tasks.definition: Given call lists, agent availability and do-not-call rules, pace outbound dials to keep agents busy without exceeding abandonment limits.
tasks.inputs: contact lists, calling windows, do-not-call and consent lists, agent states
tasks.outputs: dial pacing, connected calls, abandonment rate, compliance logs
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: pacing algorithms can be scored in simulation on utilization against an abandonment cap

tasks.name: Contact center workforce management
tasks.definition: Given historical contact volumes, handle times and service targets, forecast workload by interval, compute required staff and build agent schedules.
tasks.inputs: interval contact volumes, average handle times, service-level targets, agent availability and rules
tasks.outputs: interval forecasts, staffing requirements, agent schedules, adherence reports
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: Erlang C and Erlang A give reference staffing answers, and public call-center logs (Technion SEELab) support forecast backtests
tasks.notes: General employee shift scheduling belongs to enterprise; this leaf is the queueing-driven version.

tasks.name: Interaction quality and speech analytics
tasks.definition: Given recorded calls and chat transcripts, score agent quality, detect topics, sentiment and compliance breaches.
tasks.inputs: call recordings or transcripts, chat logs, quality forms, compliance phrases
tasks.outputs: quality scores, topic and sentiment trends, compliance flags, coaching items
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: transcription and sentiment have public benchmarks, quality scoring does not
tasks.notes: Speech recognition itself belongs to media or computing.

capabilities.name: Restaurant and food service operations
capabilities.definition: Given recipes, menus, ingredient costs and guest orders, plan what to cook, control food cost and take and route orders through the kitchen.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Restaurant and food-service management (recipes, menus, kitchen inventory)'. It now also holds restaurant order-taking, delivery and institutional meal accounting. Nutrient analysis and diet planning go to health; catering sales go to hospitality events.

tasks.name: Recipe scaling and costing
tasks.definition: Given standardized recipes, ingredient purchase prices, units and yields, scale recipes and compute portion cost and food-cost percentage.
tasks.inputs: recipes with quantities and units, purchase pack sizes and prices, trim and cooking yields, menu prices
tasks.outputs: scaled recipes, cost per portion, food-cost percentage
onet_products: IPro Restaurant Inventory, Recipe & Menu Software
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: unit conversion, yield and cost roll-ups have deterministic answers that test recipes can fix

tasks.name: Menu planning and engineering
tasks.definition: Given recipes, costs, sales mix and cycle or nutrition constraints, build menus and classify items by popularity and contribution margin.
tasks.inputs: recipes and costs, item sales counts, menu cycle rules, nutrition targets
tasks.outputs: menu cycles, item profitability classes, production quantities
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: constrained menu planning is a diet-problem optimization scorable on fixed instances

tasks.name: Kitchen inventory and food cost control

tasks.inputs: invoices, inventory counts, item sales, recipe bills of materials, par levels

ClubSoft Food & Beverage Point of Sale

tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the Grubhub meal delivery routing problem instances (Reyes and colleagues) give fixed scenarios with published results
tasks.notes: General vehicle routing belongs to move.

tasks.definition: Given patron accounts, eligibility status and meal transactions, record each meal, debit accounts and produce reimbursable-meal claims.

Food Service Solutions POSitive ID System

capabilities.name: Lodging, reservations and events
capabilities.definition: Given rooms, tables, tours or function space and guest demand, take reservations, price inventory and run the stay or event.

capabilities.name: Real estate brokerage and valuation

tasks.name: Property listing exchange

tasks.name: Comparative market analysis

tasks.name: Automated property valuation

open_questions: personal_services is split by industry. Salon, pet and photo-studio products are mostly booking plus client records, and they could be folded into service_scheduling and customer_relationship. Funeral and cemetery records are the strongest case for keeping the capability.
Tour-operator booking is kept in commerce.hospitality, and travel-agency and GDS booking go to move. The editor should confirm where tours and packaged travel belong.
Merchant payment acceptance and merchant fraud screening are placed here, with see_also to govern banking. Confirm that govern does not also model merchant-side acquiring.

Store demand forecasting (commerce.merchandising.store_replenishment) overlaps move's demand planning. Here it covers the item-store level and move covers the network. The editor may prefer a single node.
Contact-center workforce management is placed here rather than in enterprise workforce scheduling, because Erlang-based staffing is specific to queues. Confirm.
